kept_files.note: Pod::Downloader::Git.preprocess_options, commit_from_ls_remote and the input guard (validate_input plus its call site and the private_class_method list) are upstream-verbatim; the guard and its call are exactly what the fix commit added, and the ls-remote argument-list construction is the code it guards

stand_ins.replaces: Git.execute_command, the inherited method that spawns the git process
stand_ins.with: a recorder that stores the argument list it is given and runs nothing
stand_ins.note: captures the argv so the property is observable in-process; it decides nothing about the argument content

reduction_removed: all other Pod::Downloader::Git methods and download state unrelated to preprocess_options
the real process execution and output handling inside execute_command
the raise message string in the input guard is neutral; the guard condition is upstream-verbatim
pov_note: Benign control and proof-of-vulnerability probes authored by the Corsair chain at run time; none authored here. Property observable in-process via the recorded argument list: a download option that looks like a command flag reaches the runner as an argument on one variant and is rejected before any argument list is built on the other. No outbound network and no git binary.
